crossRefs.note: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
crossRefs.keyword: ever. Heb. all the day. merciful

crossRefs.note: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
crossRefs.keyword: ever. Heb. all the day. merciful

crossRefs.note: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
crossRefs.keyword: ever. Heb. all the day. merciful

crossRefs.note: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.
crossRefs.keyword: ever. Heb. all the day. merciful

crossRefs.note: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
crossRefs.keyword: ever. Heb. all the day. merciful

crossRefs.note: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be…
crossRefs.keyword: ever. Heb. all the day. merciful

crossRefs.note: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…

translations.web: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
translations.bsb: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
translations.kjv: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
translations.asv: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed.
